description: This file defines the MigrationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving version information and running database migrations during software upgrades in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for database migration during system upgrades

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch version range information for upgrades

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to execute migrations for specified versions
